prompt: By default, GitHub Actions workflows are NOT triggered after Copilot creates a PR. Why?
explanation: Per GitHub Docs, workflows are withheld until a write-access user clicks "Approve and run workflows." This prevents untrusted agent-generated code from automatically running privileged CI.

options.text: To require a user with write access to review code and explicitly approve workflow runs before execution — preventing untrusted agent code from running privileged CI jobs
